title: Meta provenance for the InkBridge v12 review checks (random selection control, ink invariance, unit counts, plain FT1% row, FM screen counts)

jobs.reason: script lacked a __main__ guard, so each spawn pool worker re-ran the analysis parts; outputs in out/ and smoke/ are not used

compute.environment: apptainer images/torch27.sif, venvs/uhwr_eval02/bin/python, PYTHONPATH=shared/uhwr_eval-0.3.1, e0/code_4cd40f57 appended for e0_adapter.unpack_ink

method.randctl: Per cell (29 specs of exp/RQF/R3/read_all3 plus exp/ORDER/sealed/COMP_rep3/read/spec_test_ouhdl.json) and metric (loop_tables.MET, 8 metrics): per-unit sample-mean tables via loop_tables.load_cell/unit_table (native protocol); contrast COMP_rep3 minus COMP_pool3 (selected minus mean of its three candidates) and COMP_rnd3 minus COMP_pool3; inner join on unit, dropna; writer-cluster bootstrap loop_tables.boot_idx, B=2000, rng 20261029, percentile 95% interval and Bonferroni-8 interval (0.3125 and 99.6875 percentiles); strict pairing = per training seed, selected minus mean of the three candidate rows, all four values required. Integrity checks per training seed: unit-set equality, file-stem match, gt_sha256, evaluator, row equality of the selected row with candidate rows on 10 columns (atol 1e-12), sampling sidecar comparison for R3 pairs. Stored flags read from R3_summary_3seed_cells.csv, cells_*.json and RV10/tables/facts_v11_v2/L08_control_per_cell.csv.
method.ft1abs: Functions boot_counts, boot, load, peritem copied verbatim from exp/RQF/code/rqf_paired_ext.py; common units = intersection of its 9 methods; plain FT1% = COMP_pool3 files of the ORDER sealed spec (9 files); writer-cluster multinomial bootstrap, default_rng(0), B=2000, ratio of sums.
method.n4358: exp/CAND/K1/score/rows test_ouhdl LUO_ms6_identity and LUO_ms6_mirror_x, seeds 0-2, native rows; per-unit mean over seeds (NaN skipped); counts of units with direction_acc defined per arm and in both; thresholds |d direction| >= 0.5 and |d AIoU| <= 0.01.
method.inkinv: uhwr_eval 0.3.1 score(gt, variant, (64,64), protocol='native', with_lpips=False, with_frechet=False) on ground-truth inks unpacked by e0_adapter.unpack_ink; 500 units per set chosen by default_rng(20261115).choice without replacement; variants: reverse_points, reorder_reversed, reorder_random (rng 20261115+unit index), reverse_points_and_order; diagnostics: to_nagamatsu points, integer pixels, _render_trajectory masks at thickness 1 and 2.
method.screen: Counter of 'status' over exp/FMD/xs/verdicts/verdict_*.json and value counts of exp/FMD/xs/read_v1/v1_1_fmdx_gate_read.csv.

column_notes.checks_v12_results.csv: one row per cell and metric; sel_minus_mean3_* = selected minus mean of three candidates; rnd_minus_mean3_* = stored random pick minus the same mean; *_stored_* = values in the stored paired_<cell>.csv; *_bonf8_* = interval at level 1-0.05/8; *_strict_* = strict pairing; cell-level stored flags repeated on each row.
column_notes.checks_v12_randctl_cells.csv: one row per cell; integrity counters are sums over training seeds (n_train); L08_* from the v11 L08 file.
column_notes.checks_v12_ft1abs.csv: one row per method; <metric>, <metric>_lo, <metric>_hi, <metric>_ndef as in absolute_common_units.csv; FT1pct_plain and FT1pct_plain_A4000cmp are new rows.
column_notes.checks_v12_inkinv.csv: one row per set and variant plus ALL_7_SETS.
column_notes.checks_v12_inkinv_units.csv: one row per sampled unit and variant.

deviations: inkinv uses 500 sampled units for OUHD-L (of 4,406), UNIPEN-de (of 827) and OnHW (of 5,925); the other four sets are complete (500 of 500).
Sampling sidecars compared for the 41 R3 model-set pairs; not checked for the 3 pairs of the ORDER sealed FT1% Urdu cell.
Bonferroni-8 percentile bounds rest on B=2000 draws (about 6 draws in each tail).
